stacks.name: The $0 Full-Stack Web App

layers.detail: Unlimited static bandwidth (Cloudflare) or 100 GB + serverless (Vercel)

layers.detail: Postgres with branching, or Postgres + auth + storage bundled

layers.pick: Clerk free (10k MAU) or Supabase Auth (50k MAU)

The zero-egress trick that keeps surprise bills away
Enough for signups + password resets of a young product
Know when things break before users tell you

layers.pick: PostHog free (1M events) or self-host Umami

layers.pick: GitHub Actions (2,000 min/mo, free for OSS)
